name: B10-0424/2026 – After recital E – Am 53
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: Ea. whereas the wearing of the Islamic veil, particularly when imposed on young girls, raises profound concerns regarding equality between women and men, personal autonomy and the protection of children; whereas within the context of Islamic ecosystems, the practice of wearing a veil cannot invariably be considered a fully free and uncoerced choice, as it is often enforced through family and social pressure;
